"""Verify V166 readiness copies,source bindings,prefix objectives and all units."""
import ast
import importlib.util
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import torch
import yaml
from train_directional_bank_trial import read,ref,save,guard
from train_v43_quality_trial import live
from demosaic.prediction_archive import fingerprint
repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V167-bounded-support-v1'
index=repo/'docs/results/v167-bounded-support-preparation-v1.json';prep=read(index)
assert len(prep['copies'])==16
for item in prep['copies'].values():
 assert ref(item['original']['path'])==item['original'] and ref(item['public']['path'])==item['public']
 assert Path(item['original']['path']).read_bytes()==Path(item['public']['path']).read_bytes()
bundle=read(prep['sources']['path']);assert len(bundle['source_texts'])==56
for item in bundle['source_texts']+[bundle['publisher']]:
 assert ref(item['path'])['sha256']==item['sha256'] and Path(item['path']).read_text()==item['text']
 if Path(item['path']).suffix=='.py':ast.parse(item['text'])
plan=read(root/'plan-v1.json');guard(plan);guard(read(root/'postprocess-plan-v1.json'))
assert len(bundle['neural_hashes'])==90
for p,h in bundle['neural_hashes'].items():assert ref(p)['sha256']==ref(repo/'src/demosaic'/Path(p).name)['sha256']==h
helper=repo/'.cache/audit-v167-training-objective-v1.py';spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('v167_ledger',helper)
ledger=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(ledger)
import json
prefix=[json.loads(s) for s in (root/'readiness-training-prefix-v1.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
assert len(prefix)==40;recipe=yaml.safe_load(Path(plan['config']['path']).read_text());cache=read(plan['cache']['path'])
for row,item in zip(prefix,cache['batches'][:40],strict=True):
 adc=item['metadata']['noise']['shot']==item['metadata']['noise']['read']==0
 for arm,c in row['arms'].items():
  assert ledger.reconstruct(c,recipe,recipe['arms'][arm],row['domain'],adc).tobytes()==np.float32(c['loss']).tobytes()
  assert c['common_support_detached']==bool(recipe['arms'][arm]['common_detach_support'] and c['coupled_pairs'])
  assert c['declared_support_floor']==recipe['arms'][arm]['support_floor']
  assert c['declared_support_floor']<=c['support_minimum']<=c['support_maximum']<=1
units=read(plan['pair_unit_table']['path'])['rows'];assert len(units)==1000
for item,table in zip(cache['batches'],units,strict=True):
 raw=np.sqrt(np.asarray(item['metadata']['sensor'].get('increment_mean_variance',[]),dtype=np.float32))
 values=np.maximum(raw,np.float32(2/65535)).reshape(-1,1,1,1)
 assert values.tobytes()==np.asarray(table['candidate_units_FP32'],dtype=np.float32).reshape(table['shape']).tobytes()
 assert fingerprint(np.maximum(raw,np.float32(16/65535)).reshape(-1,1,1,1))==item['inputs']['pair_units']
snapshot=read(root/'prepared-live-snapshot-v1.json');assert all(live(o) for o in snapshot['owners'])
assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
output=repo/'docs/results/v167-bounded-support-preparation-verification-v1.json';assert not output.exists()
save(output,{'status':'pass-readiness-source-neural-prefix-loss-and-unit-bindings','preparation':ref(index),
 'exact_receipts':16,'source_texts':56,'neural_sources':90,'unchanged_prior_neural_sources':89,'new_neural_modules':1,'actual_prefix_rows':40,'bit_exact_FP32_prefix_losses':80,
 'independent_unit_records':1000,'original_floor16_fingerprints':1000,'CUDA_initialized':False,'new_forwards':0,
 'source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text())})
print('PASS16 receipts/56 source texts/90 modules/80 actual losses and support bounds/1000 units;no CUDA')
